scoring_justification: Recompute total binding energy variation and monotonicity along each azimuth from the submitted dispersion data; no external gold labels required.

outputs.description: Binding energy of the nitrogen-derived surface band as a function of parallel momentum along Γ̄-Ȳ and Γ̄-X̄. The checker verifies that along 'GammaY' binding energy increases with k_parallel (dispersion to higher binding energy) with total variation in the range 0.6–1.2 eV, and along 'GammaX' binding energy is nearly constant (variation ≤ 0.3 eV).

output_contract.notes: The structural model parameters (missing‑row, N site, bond lengths, interlayer distances) are provided in the instruction. The checker only scores the dispersion trend and magnitude; exact agreement with a specific DFT functional is not required.

steps.description: Verify anisotropic dispersion: along GammaY binding energy increases with k_parallel and total variation within 0.6-1.2 eV; along GammaX nearly constant (variation ≤ 0.3 eV)
